findings.fact: Decision publisher constructor delegates to D3.from_pretrained; low_cpu_mem_usage is consumed/ignored as a loader compatibility flag, not a project streaming implementation.

Publisher asks Qwen3_5Model.from_pretrained for BF16, SDPA, one selected CUDA device. The FP32 readout is separately load_file then copied to the device. Largest and Edge runtime executable ASTs match; only a documentation paragraph differs.
Selected Transformers5.17 normally instantiates model parameters under torch.device(meta), then loads checkpoint data; no ordinary full initialized CPU backbone is required by this branch.

Local safetensors loading normally uses safe_open backend mmap/deviceCPU and stores lazy get_slice handles for all checkpoint files, before conversion and placement. Explicit disable_mmap or HF mount detection chooses full-byte loading instead.

Per-tensor materialization performs tensor[...] then .to(selected device,dtype). Default path submits futures to at most4 workers. HF_DEACTIVATE_ASYNC_LOAD disables this async path and uses deferred callables. HF_ENABLE_PARALLEL_LOADING=false / HF_PARALLEL_LOADING_WORKERS=1 in current actor environment do not control this5.17 branch. Inherited HF_DEACTIVATE_ASYNC_LOAD was not separately recorded, so actual concurrency is not proven.

proposal: A separately named measured serial mmap/meta loading profile can explicitly set HF_DEACTIVATE_ASYNC_LOAD=1 and measure constructor peak host MemAvailable, cgroup memory.current/peak/events, CUDA allocated/reserved peaks and preserved host reserve. This is a candidate resource optimization, not qualification or authorization to change the original conservative floors. Keep historical sources and current baseline profile frozen; preserve BF16/FP32/readout/code/prompt/attention/batch8/native255/text48 numerics and no-swap/owned limits. Actual fit and transient bound remain unmeasured; mmap mapping size alone does not prove physical residency or UMA credit.
